description_en: A fantastic villa with a swimming pool which has been serving for years as a Hotel - Bar - Restaurant is ideal for Agritourism!! Only 20 minutes away from Tirana, you will find a fantastic environment, between clean air and greenery. The villa has been operating for years as a Hotel-Bar-Restaurant, invested in details. The object is located on the edge of the main road in the road segment Kashar - Peze. Information on the property: Total surface area 1098 m2 of land Are + Land + buildings From this surface area are Land 619 m2 and building surface 417. 3 m2 - Floor 0 (zero) with a surface of about 530m2; consists of: 1 (one) dining room for 50 (+) people; 2 covered verandas, 3 toilets. Large kitchen + 2 toilets (one dedicated to the pool); *Floor 0 also has access to the Pool. - 1st floor (first) with an area of ​​380m2 The first floor consists of: - 2 living rooms; - 5 bedrooms; - 3 porches; - 3 toilets (jacuzzi) - Living room with fireplace; The 2nd (second) floor has an area of ​​about 330m2 and consists of: Two Apartments with two bedrooms + Verandah + toilets each. The garden has an area of ​​about 3000 m2. The pool measures 5.5 x 11. Around the pool there is 150 m of space for sunbeds. Wine cellar in the basement. 7 + parking spaces *Currently in a rental contract with a value of 5000 Euro/Month. For a visit to the property, contact us!
